name: resume-assistant
description: AI resume expert for polishing, scoring, job tailoring and multi-format export.

displayDescription.en: Scores resumes on a 100-point rubric, polishes with a 40+ item checklist, tailors content for specific jobs, and exports to Word, Markdown, HTML, LaTeX or PDF.
displayDescription.zh: 提供百分制专业评分、四十项深度清单润色、岗位匹配定制与多格式导出，全面打造高竞争力求职简历。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Score my resume and tell me how to improve it
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我评分并优化这份简历

quickPrompts.en: Score my resume and tell me how to improve it
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我评分并优化这份简历

quickPrompts.en: Tailor my resume for this job description
quickPrompts.zh: 根据岗位描述定制我的简历
